title.full: When you can withdraw CPF savings early

summary.text: You can apply before 55 if a medical condition reduces life expectancy, affects work ability, or causes permanent lack of mental capacity.

details.heading: Medical conditions that may qualify
details.body: You can apply to withdraw your CPF savings earlier if you have a medical condition that reduces your life expectancy, causes you to be permanently unfit for work, or causes you to lack mental capacity permanently.
